GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that she had intended to lead the event, however, after her mount obtained the lead in the initial stages, another runner displayed superior early speed & rather than engage in a speed battle, she elected to settle her mount & allow that runner to cross near the 800m. She stated that her mount travelled only fairly behind the fast early tempo & after being let off the bridle approaching the home turn, the mare failed to quicken & was one paced in the run to the line. Vet no abs. Trainer dissatisfied with recovery & vet report no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Inside the 700m faltered, became unbalanced and as a result lost momentum. Rider reported that he initially had concerns that the horse may have gone amiss, however it appeared to travel better after the 600m. A post-race veterinarian examination revealed the gelding exhibited moderate signs of heat stress. Trainer was advised a veterinary clearance would be required prior to next trial/ race start. V/C received
